# Kookie UI snapshot

Flow pins `@kushagradhawan/kookie-ui-react@0.0.0-flow.5`, packed from `kookie-ui-v2` at `e683e4d` (PR #65, RowGroup and Navigator). Only the version in package/package.json differs from v2's own `pnpm pack` output.

To refresh: build `packages/ui` in kookie-ui-v2, pack it, bump the `flow.N` version, and update every reference. A new version is required; pnpm reuses a lockfile entry whose name and version are unchanged.
